hub.video_body: Turn a reference frame or a text prompt into a short Seedance clip with camera motion control.

video.reference_hint: Pick a character or upload an image to use as the first frame. Without an image the clip is generated from text only.
video.reference_why_body: A reference image tells the video model exactly what the first frame should look like. Use it to keep a character, costume, or pose consistent. Without it, the clip is created from your text description alone.
video.reference_off_hint: Only the text prompt is sent to Replicate.
video.reference_on_hint: The reference image is included as the first frame.
video.reference_flow_off_body: Your action/scene description and the camera, shot, and ambience options you select below are combined into the prompt as-is. Without an image, the first frame is invented from text, so character, costume, or pose may vary each time. You can still choose aspect ratio, resolution, and duration below.
video.reference_flow_on_body: The reference image is sent as the first frame, and your action/scene description plus options are appended on top. The model keeps the character, costume, and pose shown in the image while adding motion. Aspect ratio is ignored below because it follows the reference image.
video.action_placeholder: e.g. the girl slowly turns her head and smiles
video.provider_hint: Text-to-video uses LTX Video, and image-to-video uses WAN 2.2 through Replicate.
video.generating_hint: Rendering usually takes 30 seconds to 2 minutes. Keep this page open.

playground.title: What do you want to create?
playground.subtitle: Add reference images or videos, then describe your scene. Their subjects, visual style, lighting, and motion are studied and supplied directly to the video model.
playground.create_sub: Uploaded references are analyzed and used during generation. Your prompt is required.
playground.add_files: Add or drag images and videos
playground.files_hint: Up to 6 files · images teach appearance and style · videos teach motion
playground.tag_hint_2: Pick a role for each reference below and it is added to the prompt automatically.
playground.describe_placeholder: A woman in a red coat walks through a rainy neon street, then turns toward the camera and smiles…
playground.describe_hint: Write naturally. Uploaded references are used automatically—no tags are needed.
playground.raw_mode_on: Your prompt is sent to Seedance without AI rewriting. Reference images and videos are still included.
playground.raw_mode_off: AI studies your references and refines the prompt before sending.
playground.defaults_hint_1: Default settings are preset to the most common short-form format:
playground.defaults_hint_bold: 9:16 ratio, 480p resolution, 5 seconds, 1 video, sound on
playground.pricing_note: Based on the official BytePlus pricing examples for the mainline Dreamina Seedance 2.0 model (16:9, 5s output): $0.35 / $0.76 / $1.87 per video at 480p / 720p / 1080p. Final billing can vary with the tokens reported by the provider. Uploaded videos are converted to reference frames in this playground.
